project_info.theme: Iconic food product with irresistible texture
project_info.color_palette: Brand-derived pastel or gradient background with product-led accent colors

main_subject.detail: The most iconic product from [INSERT BRAND NAME], centered and rendered with tactile appetite appeal such as cheese pull, dripping chocolate, whipped cream, or condensation.
main_subject.style: Minimal cinematic food advertising, glossy commercial product photography

items: Top: bold slogan in brand-matched color.
Center: one isolated hero food or beverage product with mouthwatering texture.
Background: uncluttered brand-inspired pastel or gradient color field.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft shadows, sharp edible textures, controlled gloss, no clutter

assets.name: Approved product reference
assets.source: official product photography or licensed food styling reference
assets.usage: Match actual food shape, ingredients, packaging, and portion.

assets.name: Food-ad layout reference
assets.usage: Match four-panel or single-product hierarchy as selected.

prompt_instructions: Attach official product and logo refs for a real brand.
Do not generate unsupported food, nutrition, or promotional claims.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A vertical 2:3 high-resolution food advertisement featuring the most iconic and delicious product from a well-known brand called [INSERT BRAND NAME]. The product appears centered with mouthwatering details - such as melted cheese, dripping chocolate, whipped cream, or condensation - depending on the product. The background should be a gradient or pastel tone inspired by the brand's identity. At the top, display a bold slogan in a color that matches the brand's style. At the bottom, include the official logo of the brand. Use cinematic studio lighting, soft shadows, and ultra-sharp textures to create a visually irresistible and minimal poster.
prompt.negative_prompt: unappetizing food, messy composition, distorted packaging, fake logo, unreadable slogan, low resolution, watermark, signature
